events.name: Bash
events.head: Find FintechCircle sender emails
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,20p workshop-plan/dogfooding/FINTECHCIRCLE_EXPERIMENT.md | cut -c1-300; grep -rhoiE "[a-z0-9._-]+@[a-z0-9.-]*fintech[a-z0-9.-]*" workshop-plan cloud/scripts ~/.config/tantra/keys 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -ohiE "[a-z0-9.-]*fintechcircle[a-z0-9.-]*\.(com|io|co|org|net)" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/*.json workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head; grep -oiE ".{200}20 (FintechCircle|Tantra sender) (mail|sender).{300}" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-155.json | head -3
